settings.question: Can I reposition or resize the design?
settings.answer: To maintain consistent print quality, all designs are automatically sized and positioned within approved print areas. You may select from available approved locations but cannot manually move or resize artwork.

settings.question: Can I upload artwork?
settings.answer: Yes. Upload a PNG, JPG or WEBP image in the Design step. It is automatically centered and scaled inside the print area you choose.

settings.question: What image quality is required?
settings.answer: For a sharp print, upload an image at least 1500 pixels wide. A transparent PNG works best. You'll see a warning if your file is low resolution.

settings.question: Will uploads be reviewed?
settings.answer: Uploaded artwork may be reviewed before production. We'll contact you if anything needs to change.

settings.question: Can I use copyrighted logos?
settings.answer: Only if you own them or have permission to use them. By uploading artwork you confirm you have the right to use it.

settings.question: Does the avatar show the exact fit?
settings.answer: No. The avatar is a design preview, not a sizing or fit simulation. Please use the size guide in the Size step.

settings.heading: Customizing questions
settings.text: Need help with your design? Our veteran-owned team is here to help.
